transkript.t: 10 free AI tools on GitHub that do the work of an entire dev team, ranked by stars.
9. Appify. Scrapes Google Maps leads automatically.
8. Watch. Feed Claude any video link to get an instant breakdown.
7. Google Workspace CLI. Automates Gmail, Drive, and Sheets.
6. Vercel Skills. Auto installs agent capabilities.
5. Playwright. Browses and tests your web apps like a human user.
4. Humanizer. Erases robotic AI tells from your text.
3. Hyperframes. Turns HTML and GSAP into MP4 videos.
2. Orca. Runs Claude code and codecs in parallel.
1. With over 300,000 stars, REA disassembles any app down to its binary.
